method: F28: four preregistered new constructed tasks on three familiar projects, three repetitions, nine serial rotated arms. Earlier checkpoints used aggregate reconciliation alone; keep that sensitivity under observedAggregateComparisons, with gaps/reserves explicit. Exclusion for missing consumption is not evidence of better outcomes or complete-panel efficiency; all attempts and adverse partial subtotals remain visible. Cache accounting and provider invoices remain incomplete.

accounting.method: Known SDK estimates plus explicit missing-aggregate/unreported-request reserves, not imputed consumption. Wire/report counts do not establish billing or hidden retries.

limitations: Four constructed task clusters on three familiar projects, not an external issue benchmark or representative population. Within-task repeats are dependent. Single factors may never activate; do not infer mechanism benefit from mere assignment. Common instructions already require unknown skipped counts. Original RxJS legacy UI drops returned Promises: new supplied fixture uses awaited callback completion, original suite limitations remain. Compiler project scope supplied identically to RxJS arms. Native comparison changes multiple mechanisms. Prompt date is frozen by a common source-pinned projection; real clocks and durations unchanged. Provider seeds/revision,invoices,hidden retries and full request cache unknown. Official success,independent function,actual requested checks,formal admission and full user criteria remain separate.
